text: 股市资金流向图：今日沪深两市主力资金净流出165.31亿元，占比1.01%；大单资金净流出91.45亿元，占比0.56%；小单资金净流入175.88亿元，占比1.08%。
text_en: Stock Market Capital Flow Chart: Today, main funds in the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock markets recorded a net outflow of 16.531 billion yuan, accounting for 1.01%; large-order funds recorded a net outflow of 9.145 billion yuan, accounting for 0.56%; small-order funds recorded a net inflow of 17.588 billion yuan, accounting for 1.08%.
